_status: PROVISIONAL -- offsets are 0.0, so the rule is PURELY DEFINITIONAL: AT_DEPTH iff (hip_y - knee_y)/S >= deadband. bench/depth_rule_calibrate.py replaces the fitted block and sets fitted=true. Structural constants below are inherited or declared, not tuned; which is which is noted per key.

label_semantics.label_1: human-marked depth-fault instant == bottom frame of a rep that was too shallow
label_semantics.label_0: NOT a marked instant; mostly non-bottom frames. NOT a synonym for at-depth
label_semantics.negative_class_construction: bottom frames of good_form videos, via find_bottom()
label_semantics._why_it_matters: Training on label 1 vs 0 directly yields a REP-PHASE detector, not a depth checker: label-1 frames sit at median depth-percentile 0.964 of their own clip, label-0 at 0.62-0.78.

_visibility_note: INHERITED from app/ml/posture_v1/visibility.py (VISIBILITY_PARTIAL / VISIBILITY_TRUSTED) so the codebase keeps one visibility vocabulary. Not tuned here.
_structural_note: DECLARED, to be validated against depth_frames IoU rather than tuned against the verdict. smooth_seconds is in SECONDS so smoothing is fps-invariant without resampling landmarks.
_view_note: PROVISIONAL. There are no view labels anywhere in the corpus, so these two cut points are fitted as ordinary rule parameters on the train split, selected by held-out performance.
_view_floors_note: PROVISIONAL. Ordering is physical: indicators reading the femur in the image plane (I1, I2) are foreshortened front-on; I3 is an interior angle and degrades least; I5 is near view-flat. Magnitudes to be fitted.
_weights_note: PROVISIONAL, and these weight COVERAGE/confidence only -- the verdict itself is a sign test on I2 alone. I1 is weighted low because it failed the provenance gate at n=30 (r=0.8952) and passed at n=40 (r=0.9124); a gate verdict that moves with sample size is not load-bearing.
_offset_note: THE ONLY FITTED QUANTITY IN THE DECISION. 0.0 means no correction: pure definitional parallel. Corrects (a) MediaPipe landmark 23/24 not being the anatomical hip crease and 25/26 not the knee top, and (b) femur foreshortening off-axis. The THRESHOLD stays 0 and is never fitted.
_deadband_note: PROVISIONAL but evidence-backed: the Stage 0b provenance gate measured verdict agreement between pose passes of 80.0% raw, 91.7% at 0.02, and 100.0% at 0.08 (at 56.7% coverage). Final value swept on validation subject to precision >= 0.85 on AT_DEPTH.
_coverage_note: PROVISIONAL. Below this the evidence is too thin to call, regardless of where the score sits.

provenance._why: The gate measured a +0.0108 torso-length bias between the dataset's pose pass and the container's, with all six verdict disagreements running the same direction. Calibrating on dataset keypoints would bake that bias into serving.

_fallback_fps_note: Used only when a clip reports no usable fps. The corpus is 30fps (depth_frames are frame_index/30, verified exactly).
